mutations.name: a landing after the list completed closes the task
mutations.find: !lastSlice && completedBefore(slicing, landingLine(slice, landing)) ? LANDED_BEFORE_THIS_PR : heldOpenBy(slicing, lastSlice)
kills: a task its slices do not finish stays open on a follow-up slice after every block slice merged, naming what holds it

mutations.name: a replayed landing counts itself as an earlier one
kills: a task its slices do not finish closes on the slice that completes the block, and on the replay of that landing

mutations.name: --last-slice with no slice name stops at a finished list
kills: a task its slices do not finish closes on a --last-slice PR that names no slice once every block slice merged

mutations.name: a hold tag does not hold
kills: a task tagged hold:<reason> stays open when the slice that completes its block merges
a task tagged hold:<reason> stays open when a --last-slice PR merges
